content.text: I'll create a U-shaped profile with the specified dimensions. Let me start by calculating the necessary coordinates for the blocks that will form this shape.

input.PythonCode:
# U-shaped profile dimensions
width = 70  # mm
height = 40  # mm
web_thickness = 5  # mm
length = 450  # mm

# Calculate the coordinates for the three blocks that form the U-shape
# We'll create the U-shape using one main block and subtract two blocks

# Main block (full rectangle)
main_block = {
    'x': 0,
    'y': 0,
    'z': 0,
    'x_size': width,
    'y_size': length,
    'z_size': height
}

# Left cutout block (to create the left side of the U)
left_cutout = {
    'x': web_thickness,
    'y': 0,
    'z': web_thickness,
    'x_size': (width - 2*web_thickness)/2,
    'y_size': length,
    'z_size': height - web_thickness
}

# Right cutout block (to create the right side of the U)
right_cutout = {
    'x': web_thickness + (width - 2*web_thickness)/2,
    'y': 0,
    'z': web_thickness,
    'x_size': (width - 2*web_thickness)/2,
    'y_size': length,
    'z_size': height - web_thickness
}

print("Main block dimensions:")
print(f"Position: ({main_block['x']}, {main_block['y']}, {main_block['z']})")
print(f"Size: {main_block['x_size']} x {main_block['y_size']} x {main_block['z_size']}")
print()
print("Left cutout dimensions:")
print(f"Position: ({left_cutout['x']}, {left_cutout['y']}, {left_cutout['z']})")
print(f"Size: {left_cutout['x_size']} x {left_cutout['y_size']} x {left_cutout['z_size']}")
print()
print("Right cutout dimensions:")
print(f"Position: ({right_cutout['x']}, {right_cutout['y']}, {right_cutout['z']})")
print(f"Size: {right_cutout['x_size']} x {right_cutout['y_size']} x {right_cutout['z_size']}")
